glossary.name: MCG Supply Chain Glossary
glossary.description: Business glossary for Meridian Commerce Group supply chain and data platform terms.

terms.name: Phantom Inventory
terms.definition: Inventory that appears in ERP/WMS but does not physically exist in the warehouse. Caused by sync failures between systems. MCG's #1 data quality nightmare, costing $48M annually.

terms.name: IRA (Inventory Record Accuracy)
terms.definition: Percentage of SKU/location combinations where system quantity matches physical count within tolerance. MCG current: 74%, target: 97%.

terms.name: Cycle Count
terms.definition: Physical count of inventory at a specific bin location to verify system accuracy. Performed per SOP-WH-002. Used to detect phantom inventory and trigger reconciliation.

terms.name: Goods Receipt
terms.definition: Process of receiving and validating incoming merchandise at a distribution center. Includes lot number capture, quality inspection, and putaway. Per SOP-WH-001.

terms.name: Lot Number
terms.definition: Unique identifier assigned to a batch of products from a single production run. Required for food traceability per EU Regulation EC 178/2002. Missing for 15% of MCG grocery inventory.

terms.name: WISMO
terms.definition: Where Is My Order — customer inquiry about delivery status. Accounts for 41% of MCG customer service calls at $2.30 per call. Driven by carrier tracking gaps and missed SLAs.

terms.name: SLA Breach
terms.definition: Failure to deliver within the promised delivery window communicated to the customer at checkout. APAC current breach rate: 22% (target: <8%). Governed by MCG-POL-020.

terms.name: Cold Chain Exceedance
terms.definition: Temperature reading outside acceptable range for the product type. Thresholds: fresh produce >8°C for 30+ min, dairy >8°C for 15+ min, frozen any reading above -15°C.

terms.name: Delivery Promise
terms.definition: Commitment shown to customer at checkout for expected delivery date. Must reflect current carrier SLA terms. Changes must be communicated within 24 hours per MCG-POL-020.

terms.name: Pre-Cool Compliance
terms.definition: Whether transport refrigeration unit reached target temperature (0°C since Oct 2025 update) before loading begins. Updated requirement after TransFrio spoilage incident INC-2025-05102.

terms.name: CDC (Change Data Capture)
terms.definition: Technology that captures row-level insert/update/delete changes in a database and streams them to a target system in near-real-time. Used by Qlik Talend Cloud via Data Movement Gateway.

terms.name: Data Movement Gateway
terms.definition: Qlik software installed on-premises or on a cloud VM that enables secure CDC connections from databases behind firewalls to Qlik Cloud. No inbound firewall rules required.

terms.name: Trust Score
terms.definition: Qlik-calculated score (0.0-1.0) indicating overall data reliability for a dataset or record. Combines 6 dimensions: Completeness, Accuracy, Timeliness, Consistency, Uniqueness, Validity.

terms.name: Data Product
terms.definition: A governed, documented, SLA-backed dataset in the Gold layer of the Open Lakehouse, published for consumption via API, Qlik Sense, or downstream feeds. MCG has 7 data products.

terms.name: Table Recipe
terms.definition: A Qlik Talend Cloud data flow definition that reads from one Lakehouse layer, applies transformations, and writes to the next layer (Bronze→Silver or Silver→Gold).

terms.name: NVWA
terms.definition: Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit). Issued citation NVWA-2025-CIT-04412 to MCG on 12 June 2025 during Rotterdam DC inspection.

terms.name: EC 178/2002
terms.definition: EU General Food Law Regulation establishing the European Food Safety Authority and requiring 'one step back, one step forward' traceability for all food products in the EU supply chain.

terms.name: Sub-Tier Supplier
terms.definition: A supplier's supplier — e.g., the farm that supplies Fresh Direct NL, who supplies MCG. Currently 64% of MCG's food sub-tier suppliers are undocumented. Risk demonstrated by recall RCL-2025-003.

terms.name: GTIN/EAN
terms.definition: Global Trade Item Number / European Article Number. Universal product barcode identifier. Missing for 9% of MCG products (all from Americas legacy system). Key for product master harmonization.

terms.name: Bronze Layer
terms.definition: Raw landing zone in the Qlik Open Lakehouse (Apache Iceberg). Preserves original dirty data as-is from source systems. For audit, lineage, and replayable transformations.

terms.name: Silver Layer
terms.definition: Cleansed, standardized data in the Open Lakehouse. Output of 8 transformation routes. Timestamps normalized, addresses standardized, statuses canonicalized. For analysts and data scientists.

terms.name: Gold Layer
terms.definition: Business-ready data products in the Open Lakehouse. Aggregated, enriched, governed datasets with SLA backing and API sharing. For executives, downstream consumers, and AI systems.

terms.name: Carrier Status Canonical
terms.definition: MCG's standardized shipment lifecycle status codes. Maps 6+ carrier-specific vocabularies (DELIVERED/Zugestellt/Completed/Objeto entregue) to a single canonical lifecycle: LABEL_CREATED → PICKED_UP → IN_TRANSIT → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED.

terms.name: Address Quality Score
terms.definition: Per-address score (0.0-1.0) calculated during address standardization. 1.0 = complete, validated. 0.7 = minor correction. 0.4 = truncated. 0.2 = incomplete. Predicts carrier delivery success rate.

terms.name: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)
terms.definition: Unique product identifier. MCG has 3 coexisting schemes: MCG-* (global canonical), AM-* (Americas legacy), EU-* (EU legacy). Product Master Harmonization route (Route 4) resolves all to MCG-* canonical.
